m12.text: When extracting specific digits from integers, use the modulus operator (%) with 10 to isolate the units digit, ensuring consistent extraction regardless of the integer's magnitude or sign.

m13.text: Lesson: To increment each element in a list by 1, utilize list comprehension with an expression that adds 1 to each item, efficiently generating a new list with the desired transformations.

m16.text: When checking for distinct characters in a sliding window of a string, iterate through the string, comparing each character with the next two, returning False if any match is found. This ensures the window's characters are unique as required.
